title: Hosted API: multi-zone gradual gateway cutover with telemetry pause gates
creator: Anika Patel
description: Objective: Harden the Hosted API deployment pipeline by implementing a multi-zone gateway-level cutover mechanism that shifts traffic gradually between API gateway versions (or control-plane routing configs) using telemetry-driven pause gates and fast rollback fences. This ticket covers the gateway-side traffic shaping primitives, a small stateful controller to coordinate weight ramps across zones, integration with LTS channel metadata, and the runbook/automation to perform emergency drain or immediate rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway controller can express per-zone weights and apply them atomically within 5s of decision
Automated telemetry pause gate pauses ramp on any of: error_rate > 1.0%, P99 latency increase > 35% over baseline, or cache-thrash events detected
Cutover runbook executes a safe ramp: 0% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with configurable dwell times and automatic rollback on gate fail
Can perform a full rollback in <120s from detection, including draining in-flight KV cache warmers and invalidating prefix caches to avoid serving stale outputs
Controller logs all weight-change decisions and emits events that map to Console rollout UI and SLO dashboards
E2E tests simulate zone failure and verify fallback routes direct to compatible model variant without request loss
technical_notes: We will implement the controller as a small Kubernetes deployment in the control plane namespace; it exposes a leader-elected HTTP API to accept cutover plans
Weight changes are committed using versioned gateway-config objects with an immutable 'cutover-id' to allow audit and deterministic rollback

Traffic shift uses an incremental token-bucket throttle at the gateway edge to smooth spike behavior. Initial implementation will rely on envoy weighted clusters + token bucket filter (Ratelimit extension)
Telemetry pause gates evaluate metrics derived from the metrics API: per-route errors, per-model latency histograms, KV cache hit/miss ratios, and model regression alerts from Optimize
KV cache warming: when a zone is promoted, a background warm process uses sampled production prefixes (sanitized) to prepopulate local caches. Warmers must be cancelable on rollback
LTS channel pinning: allow operator to pin traffic to an LTS channel label in the gateway-config; controller will refuse cross-LTS automatic upgrades unless force flag is set
Security: weight-change API requires mTLS and RBAC role 'release-controller'; audit entries are uploaded to the central audit log with cutover-id and invoked-by metadata
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Dry run: apply cutover-id with zero weights across staging zones and validate audit events
Phase 1 - Canary: 5% global traffic across lowest-impact region for 10 minutes; gates must pass; if any gate trips, auto rollback to previous weights
Phase 2 - Incremental zone ramps: increase to 20% then 50% on a per-zone cadence with 15m dwell; cross-zone pacing ensures we never move >30% of global capacity within a 30m window
Phase 3 - Bulk promotion: after successful zone ramps, promote residual traffic to 100% and run final validation for 30 minutes before marking release as completed

Emergency rollback: set cutover controller to immediate-drain mode which flips weights to baseline and marks the cutover-id as failed; background warmers are cancelled and KV caches rolled back using previously checkpointed snapshots
metrics: Primary SLOs: P99 tail latency (tokens) and request success rate; target: no >3% relative regression during any dwell window
Gate thresholds: error_rate > 1.0% (10m window), p99 latency increase > 35% vs baseline (5m rolling), kv_cache_miss_rate increase > 2x
Operational metrics: time-to-complete-rollout, time-to-rollback, number of gate-triggered rollbacks per release
Observability events: cutover-id, per-zone weight timeline, gate-evaluation events with reasons and metric snapshots

(ENG) Build weight coordinator service with leader election and atomic commit path
(ENG) Wire telemetry pause gates to metrics API and Optimize alerts
(ENG) Implement token-bucket smoothing on edge via envoy filter and test under burst traffic
(SRE) Add runbook steps for emergency-drain and KV cache snapshot/restore
(SRE) Add dashboard panels and alerting rules for cutover events and gate triggers
(QA) Create e2e tests: zone failure, latency regression, cache-warm/rollback
(SEC) Security review of weight-change API and RBAC for release-controller role
